shots.scene: 欣欣站在微生物实验室门口，门上有生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the door of a microbiology lab with a biohazard warning sign on the door and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到微生物实验室。
overlay: 微生物实验室的生物安全措施

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现四个图标：台阶、安全柜、喷壶、灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to four floating icons: a staircase with four steps, a biological safety cabinet, a spray bottle and an autoclave.
shots.narration: 今天讲四件事：等级、安全柜、去污、废物。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一盘长满菌落的培养皿走向普通实验台
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries a culture dish full of colonies toward an open lab bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰要挑菌落、打散菌液。

shots.scene: 阿杰准备在敞开台面上剧烈振荡离心管
shots.prompt_en: The young male student is about to vortex a tube on the open bench; tiny droplets are drawn in the air around it.
shots.narration: 他打算在敞开的台面上猛振。

shots.scene: 小研抬手示意，指向生物安全柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student raises a hand and points to a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 小研说：这一步会产生气溶胶。

shots.scene: 欣欣点头，在空白白板前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods in front of a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 生物安全措施，我们一条条看。

shots.section_title: 生物安全：微生物实验室的核心措施
shots.scene: 实验室安全措施的几块拼图，其中一块带生物危害标志被点亮
shots.prompt_en: Several puzzle pieces for lab safety; one piece with a biohazard warning sign lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室安全有很多方面。
overlay: 生物安全：微生物实验室的核心措施

shots.section_title: 生物安全：微生物实验室的核心措施
shots.scene: 培养皿上方飘着看不见的小点，被罩子罩住
shots.prompt_en: Tiny invisible dots above culture dishes are held inside a transparent dome. No people.
shots.narration: 微生物实验室，最核心的是生物安全。

shots.section_title: 生物安全：微生物实验室的核心措施
shots.scene: 人形、实验室、社区三层同心圆
shots.prompt_en: Three concentric circles: a person icon in the center, a lab icon, then a town icon outside. No people.
shots.narration: 护住自己，也不让微生物跑出去。

shots.section_title: 按微生物选对防护等级
shots.scene: 四级台阶，从绿到红，标着1到4
shots.prompt_en: Four steps rising from green to red, marked with numbers one to four only. No people.
shots.narration: 防护等级从一级到四级。
overlay: 按微生物选对防护等级

shots.section_title: 按微生物选对防护等级
shots.scene: 不同菌种图标分别走上不同台阶
shots.prompt_en: Different microbe icons each walk onto a different step. No people.
shots.narration: 按所操作微生物的危害，

shots.section_title: 按微生物选对防护等级
shots.scene: 微生物图标走进对应等级的实验室门
shots.prompt_en: A microbe icon walks through a lab door marked with the matching step color. No people.
shots.narration: 遵守相应的生物安全防护等级。

shots.section_title: 产生气溶胶的操作进安全柜
shots.scene: 移液、振荡、离心、打开管盖四个图标冒出小飞沫
shots.prompt_en: Four icons each releasing tiny droplets: pipetting, vortexing, centrifuging and opening a tube cap. No people.
shots.narration: 移液、振荡、离心、开盖，都会产生气溶胶。
overlay: 产生气溶胶的操作进安全柜

shots.section_title: 产生气溶胶的操作进安全柜
shots.scene: 小研在生物安全柜里振荡，前窗拉到正常高度
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student vortexes a tube inside a biological safety cabinet with the front sash at working height.
shots.narration: 这些操作要放进生物安全柜。

shots.section_title: 产生气溶胶的操作进安全柜
shots.scene: 安全柜示意图：气流从前窗吸入，经过过滤器
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a biological safety cabinet: air drawn in at the front opening and passing through a filter at the top. No people.
shots.narration: 柜内气流把飞沫挡在里面。

shots.section_title: 产生气溶胶的操作进安全柜
shots.scene: 处理感染性材料的图标进安全柜
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a culture tube with a biohazard warning sign moving into a biological safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 涉及感染性材料的操作，也在柜里做。

shots.section_title: 产生气溶胶的操作进安全柜
shots.scene: 敞开台面振荡的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of vortexing on an open bench, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 敞开台面上做，飞沫会飘满房间。

shots.scene: 小研用喷壶和纸巾擦拭安全柜台面
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves, sprays disinfectant from a blank-labeled bottle and wipes the cabinet work surface.
shots.narration: 用完的台面要去污。

shots.scene: 移液器、离心机、振荡器图标被擦拭
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a pipette, a centrifuge and a vortex mixer being wiped with a cloth. No people.
shots.narration: 用过的仪器设备，也一样要擦。

shots.scene: 三个废物容器：黄色袋、利器盒、废液桶
shots.prompt_en: Three waste containers side by side: a yellow bag with a biohazard warning sign, a sharps container, and a liquid waste container. No people.
shots.narration: 生物废物要按规程处置。

shots.scene: 王老师翻开空白废物处置规程
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator opens a blank waste disposal procedure binder.
shots.narration: 每个实验室都有自己的处置规程。

shots.scene: 生物废物丢进普通垃圾桶被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A bag with a biohazard warning sign being tossed into an ordinary trash bin, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能当普通垃圾扔掉。

shots.section_title: 感染性废物，先灭菌再处置
shots.scene: 封好口的黄色废物袋放进高压灭菌器
shots.prompt_en: A sealed yellow bag with a biohazard warning sign placed into an autoclave. No people.
shots.narration: 感染性废物，先高压灭菌。
overlay: 感染性废物，先灭菌再处置

shots.section_title: 感染性废物，先灭菌再处置
shots.scene: 老李戴耐热手套操作灭菌器，旁边指示卡变色
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, wearing heat-resistant gloves, operates an autoclave; a blank indicator card changes color.
shots.narration: 灭菌合格了，再往外送。

shots.section_title: 感染性废物，先灭菌再处置
shots.scene: 灭菌后的废物交给统一回收车
shots.prompt_en: Treated waste bags are handed to a collection cart with a biohazard warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 灭菌之后，再进行处置。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在四级台阶旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the four colored steps.
shots.narration: 按微生物危害，守对防护等级。

shots.scene: 安全柜和喷壶两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a biological safety cabinet and a spray bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 气溶胶操作进柜，台面设备及时去污。

shots.scene: 灭菌器和废物袋图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an autoclave and a sealed yellow waste bag. No people.
shots.narration: 生物废物按规程，感染性先灭菌。

shots.scene: 阿杰在生物安全柜里平稳地操作
shots.prompt_en: The young male student, in proper lab coat, gloves and goggles, works calmly inside a biological safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 阿杰这回，把振荡搬进了安全柜。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰在实验室门口挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student wave goodbye at the lab door.
shots.narration: 措施做到位，安全有保障，下次见！
